title: Grill the open design questions for grilling, Q&A threads and features
description: Run the grilling skill over the open questions in HANDOVER §4 (column vs flag, thread entry mutability, threads in GET /api/board, features C1 vs C2, feature status, feature Q&A, upgrade explicitness, grilling writing answers via CLI). Blocks the feature cards.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every open question in HANDOVER §4 has a recorded decision
HANDOVER.md design section updated with the decisions

notes: Grilled 2026-10-31 in 4 rounds (22 questions). Decisions in HANDOVER §4. Notable changes vs the proposal: Q&A inside the card file (not separate files), editable entries, optional author, no resolve-without-answer, semver per file with upgrade-on-read instead of an explicit upgrade command. Three new cards: edit locks, diff reconciliation, question webhook.
